figurative_meaning_en: In front; face to face but not in direct encounter
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাকে মুখে মুখে দেখলাম কিন্তু কথা বলিনি।
সভায় সবাই মুখে মুখে বসে আছে কিন্তু কেউ খোলাখুলি কিছু বলছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: I saw him face to face but didn't speak directly.
Everyone is sitting face to face in the meeting but no one is speaking openly.
note: This idiom emphasizes physical proximity without direct verbal or confrontational engagement, common in Bengali social nuances.
